integrationAcceptance.method: Built isolated NSIS integration installers from the unpacked 1.27.1 payload; installation, overwrite and uninstall paths ran under a system temporary directory.

runningProcessStopFixture.fixture: node.exe copied as Win-Box.exe; process-name-compatible harness fixture, not the packaged application process

installerRegression.notes: The regression suite uses isolated temporary installer fixtures. It verifies the real NSIS script and lifecycle, while its active-app stop scenario uses a Node executable renamed Win-Box.exe.

candidatePayloadRollback.appDataIsolation: APPDATA and LOCALAPPDATA pointed to a dedicated temporary profile; the profile and harness workspace were removed after the run.

notVerified: The shipping Setup.exe itself was not installed; this is an integration acceptance built from the unpacked payload, not a shipping-Setup clean-install pass.
Hidden or background playback was not tested.
Upgrade migration from a real existing installation and user data was not tested.

The packaged Win-Box.exe itself was not launched for the process-stop check; the isolated regression used node.exe copied as Win-Box.exe to avoid starting the real application or its GUI. Actual packaged-process shutdown therefore remains unverified.
Interactive Cancel/Back and elevation/UAC behavior were not automated; Cancel is covered only by installer-script assertions.
